plugin_desc: Used to collect and monitor key metrics for PostgreSQL database health and performance.
name: Postgres

metrics.name: postgresql_numbackends
metrics.description: Monitors active database sessions to assess concurrency load and connection pool usage

metrics.name: postgresql_xact_commit_rate
metrics.description: Indicates frequency of committed transactions, reflecting business activity

metrics.name: postgresql_xact_rollback_rate
metrics.description: Tracks rollback frequency caused by failures or conflicts

metrics.name: postgresql_tup_returned_rate
metrics.description: Counts rows returned in query result sets

metrics.name: postgresql_tup_fetched_rate
metrics.description: Monitors rows fetched from storage during queries

metrics.name: postgresql_tup_inserted_rate
metrics.description: Tracks row insertion frequency

metrics.name: postgresql_tup_updated_rate
metrics.description: Reflects data modification activity

metrics.name: postgresql_tup_deleted_rate
metrics.description: Monitors data deletion activity

metrics.name: postgresql_blks_hit_rate
metrics.description: Reflects shared buffer cache efficiency

metrics.name: postgresql_blks_read_rate
metrics.description: Evaluates disk I/O load and cache misses

metrics.name: postgresql_cache_hit_ratio
metrics.description: Ratio of shared buffer cache hits to total block accesses
metrics.query: 100 * sum without (db) (rate(postgresql_blks_hit{__$labels__}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum without (db) (rate(postgresql_blks_hit{__$labels__}[5m])) + sum without (db) (rate(postgresql_blks_read{__$labels__}[5m])), 1e-6)

metrics.name: postgresql_deadlocks_rate
metrics.description: Detects transaction deadlock frequency

metrics.name: postgresql_conflicts_rate
metrics.description: Tracks conflicts caused by concurrent operations

metrics.name: postgresql_deadlocks_count
metrics.description: Number of transaction deadlocks in the current statistics window

metrics.name: postgresql_conflicts_count
metrics.description: Number of concurrency conflicts in the current statistics window

metrics.name: postgresql_temp_files_rate
metrics.description: Reflects temporary file usage by complex queries

metrics.name: postgresql_temp_bytes_rate
metrics.description: Measures disk usage by temp files

metrics.name: postgresql_checkpoints_timed_rate
metrics.description: Monitors system-triggered checkpoints

metrics.name: postgresql_checkpoints_req_rate
metrics.description: Reflects WAL pressure and checkpoint tuning

metrics.name: postgresql_buffers_alloc_rate
metrics.description: Tracks shared buffer allocation

metrics.name: postgresql_buffers_backend_rate
metrics.description: Represents backend-driven writes

metrics.name: postgresql_buffers_checkpoint_rate
metrics.description: Reflects checkpoint I/O impact

metrics.name: postgresql_maxwritten_clean_rate
metrics.description: Indicates high write pressure

metrics.name: postgresql_blk_write_time
metrics.description: Rate of cumulative time spent writing data file blocks (pg_stat_database.blk_write_time), expressed as milliseconds of write time accrued per second. High values indicate disk I/O write pressure or a storage bottleneck.

metrics.name: postgresql_active_time
metrics.description: Rate of cumulative time spent executing SQL statements (pg_stat_database.active_time), expressed as milliseconds of active execution accrued per second. Sustained high values indicate abnormally long-running or heavily concurrent statement execution.

metrics.name: postgresql_sessions_killed
metrics.description: Rate of database sessions terminated by fatal errors such as administrator commands, idle-session timeout, or deadlock resolution (pg_stat_database.sessions_killed), expressed as sessions per second. A rising rate signals connection instability.

metrics.name: postgresql_statement_time
metrics.description: Cumulative time for one statement, in seconds. A point means the statement was collected. Turn on Top SQL Collection. The target database must have pg_stat_statements installed.
metrics.query: topk(20, max by (instance_id, datname, queryid, query_text) (postgresql_statement_total_time_seconds{__$labels__}))

metrics.name: postgresql_statement_calls
metrics.description: Cumulative executions for one statement. Shown together with the statements that have the most cumulative time. Turn on Top SQL Collection.
metrics.query: max by (instance_id, datname, queryid, query_text) (postgresql_statement_calls_total{__$labels__}) and on (instance_id, datname, queryid) topk(20, max by (instance_id, datname, queryid) (postgresql_statement_total_time_seconds{__$labels__}))

metrics.name: postgresql_statement_rows
metrics.description: Cumulative rows returned by one statement. Shown together with the statements that have the most cumulative time. Turn on Top SQL Collection.
metrics.query: max by (instance_id, datname, queryid, query_text) (postgresql_statement_rows_total{__$labels__}) and on (instance_id, datname, queryid) topk(20, max by (instance_id, datname, queryid) (postgresql_statement_total_time_seconds{__$labels__}))

metrics.name: postgresql_statement_time_rate
metrics.description: Time consumed per second by one statement, for the trend within the current window. Turn on Top SQL Collection.
metrics.query: sum by (instance_id, datname, queryid, query_text) (rate(postgresql_statement_total_time_seconds{__$labels__}[5m])) and on (instance_id, datname, queryid) topk(20, max by (instance_id, datname, queryid) (postgresql_statement_total_time_seconds{__$labels__}))

metrics.name: postgresql_wait_sessions
metrics.description: Sessions currently in this wait. This is a sample of current sessions, not cumulative wait time. Turn on Wait Event Collection. An empty result means no session was waiting at collection time.

metrics.name: postgresql_recovery_in_recovery
metrics.description: Whether the instance is in recovery. 0 means it accepts writes (primary, including a standalone). 1 means a standby still replaying. No value means the role is unknown.

metrics.name: postgresql_replication_streaming_replicas
metrics.description: Connected streaming replication peers right now. Above zero means a primary with replicas. Zero is a real sample, not a missing point. This is not replication lag.

metrics.name: postgresql_replication_replication_slots
metrics.description: Replication slots on this instance, including slots whose peer is not connected. Above zero means replication topology. Zero is a real sample. This is not slot lag.

metrics.name: postgresql_replication_write_lag_seconds
metrics.description: Longest time a connected replica has taken to write received WAL. Zero when no streaming replica is connected.

metrics.name: postgresql_replication_flush_lag_seconds
metrics.description: Longest time a connected replica has taken to flush received WAL. Zero when no streaming replica is connected.

metrics.name: postgresql_replication_replay_lag_seconds
metrics.description: Longest time a connected replica has taken to replay received WAL. Zero when no streaming replica is connected.

metrics.name: postgresql_replication_slot_restart_lag_bytes
metrics.description: Most WAL still retained for a replication slot. Zero when no slot is retaining WAL.
